description: Download TikTok and Douyin videos as MP4, MP3, or photos ZIP — anonymously, without watermark. Supports single downloads, audio extraction, and batch mode (Business plan).

environmentVariables.name: DLTIK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key for Pro/Business tier (higher rate limits and batch downloads). Get yours at https://dltik.app/pro

environmentVariables.name: DLTIK_LOCALE
environmentVariables.description: Language for tool descriptions and error messages. Supported: en, fr, es, pt-br, ar, de. Defaults to en.
